name: Ras el Hanout Chickpea and Spinach Stew
modifications: Scaled from 2 to 4 servings (batch: dinner for 2 + next-day office lunches for 2). Serve over rice for extra calories.
steps: Cook rice according to package instructions (300g for 4 servings).

Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large pot over medium. Add the garlic and ras el hanout, stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, until it darkens slightly, about 2 minutes.
Add the stock, soy sauce and salt. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook 10 minutes until sauce darkens and flavours meld.

Add the chickpeas and simmer until warmed through and soft, about 10 minutes. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, about 3 minutes. Taste and adjust salt. Add a splash of stock or water if too thick.
Make the harissa oil: mix 3 tablespoons olive oil with the harissa paste in a small bowl.
Serve warm over rice with a dollop of Greek yogurt and a drizzle of harissa oil. Pack 2 portions for tomorrow's lunches.

nutrition_per_serving.source: estimated — same per-serving as base recipe (nutrition scales linearly). Stew only, not including rice side.

notes: Batch cook — dinner tonight + office lunches tomorrow. Rice adds ~200 kcal per serving.
